A1_definition_lock.rationale: All normative terms operationally defined: System Access (3 states), Abuse Event (3 criteria), Abuse Taxonomy (bounded classification with thresholds).

A2_authority_declaration.rationale: Exemplary authority declaration. Primary (AC) and Final (System Owner) authorities explicitly identified with scope constraints, legitimacy sources (appointment + charter), revocation mechanisms (immediate), and comprehensive conflict rules (AC-AC, AC-Owner, ownership dispute). Freeze-on-dispute rule present.

A3_irreversibility_control.rationale: No irreversible actions. All revocations appealable, suspensions auto-expire, restoration process explicit. Safeguards prevent permanent harm.

A4_failure_enumeration.rationale: Six governance failure modes enumerated: authority laundering, revocation abuse, conflict deadlock, taxonomy drift, appeal suppression, owner capture. Mitigations specified.

A5_recursive_containment.rationale: Self-amendment explicitly prohibited. Amendments require System Owner approval + Charter reference + public comment. Scope expansion prohibited. External governance required.

usage_quotes: The ability to authenticate to and use designated system capabilities.
normative_terms.definition_quote: Access is either: ACTIVE (can authenticate), SUSPENDED (temporarily blocked, ≤ 30 days), REVOKED (permanently blocked)

usage_quotes: An event satisfying ALL of the following...
normative_terms.definition_quote: 1. Violation of documented acceptable use policy (AUP), 2. Confirmed by automated logging AND human review, 3. Severity classification of MEDIUM or higher per abuse taxonomy

usage_quotes: Severity classification of MEDIUM or higher per abuse taxonomy
normative_terms.definition_quote: A bounded classification system with three severity levels: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH (See Appendix A for complete taxonomy and examples)

authorities.name: Access Controller (AC)
authorities.scope: Execute suspension and revocation decisions; limited to access modification only
authorities.legitimacy_source: Derived from appointment by System Owner and technical certification (ARP-CERT-001)
authorities.revocation: System Owner may revoke AC designation at any time; takes effect immediately upon registry update
authorities.conflict_rule: AC-to-AC: access remains ACTIVE until System Owner decides OR majority vote if ≥3 ACs. AC-to-Owner: System Owner decision is final.
evidence_quotes: Primary Authority: Access Controller (AC) - Power: Execute suspension and revocation decisions
Access Controller legitimacy: Derived from appointment by System Owner and technical certification

authorities.name: System Owner
authorities.scope: Appoint/revoke Access Controllers, override revocation decisions, amend this protocol
authorities.legitimacy_source: Derived from System Charter (external document, must be provided)
authorities.revocation: Governed by System Charter (external to this protocol)
authorities.conflict_rule: System Owner decision is final in AC-to-Owner conflicts. Framework FREEZES if System Owner authority is disputed.
evidence_quotes: Final Authority: System Owner - Power: Appoint/revoke Access Controllers, override revocation decisions, amend this protocol
System Owner legitimacy: Derived from System Charter (external document, must be provided)
If System Owner authority is disputed, this framework FREEZES.

amendment_clauses.quote: All amendments require: 1. System Owner approval, 2. Reference to System Charter amendment clause, 3. Public comment period (≥ 7 days) for affected users, 4. Updated version published with changelog
This framework may not modify itself.
Amendments may not: Add new irreversible actions, Grant Access Controllers powers beyond access modification, Remove appeal rights, Weaken authority declaration requirements

external_dependencies.name: System Charter
external_dependencies.impact_if_missing: CRITICAL - defines System Owner legitimacy; framework MUST NOT be instantiated without it

external_dependencies.name: Acceptable Use Policy (AUP)
external_dependencies.impact_if_missing: CRITICAL - defines prohibited behaviors; no abuse events can be confirmed without it

external_dependencies.name: Access Controller Registry
external_dependencies.impact_if_missing: CRITICAL - lists authorized ACs; cannot verify AC legitimacy without it

external_dependencies.name: Abuse Taxonomy (Appendix A)
external_dependencies.impact_if_missing: CRITICAL - provides bounded severity classification (illustrative version included)
